description:
NCTS Sicily L.NSC Department requires 54 rack-mounted uninterruptible power supplies (UPS) that support base routers, switches, and network gear. The requested UPS's will be used for the annual phase replacement of outdated and discontinued rack UPS in preparation for the 2026 ONE-NET Network Device Refresh (ONE-NET NDR). New Uninterruptable Power Supplies are needed for the protection of critical network assets necessary for mission functions for the NASSIG and tenant commands.

QTY 54

MODEL: APC SMARTUPS 1500VA OR EQUAL

IOOOW/1500VA, 120V/230V 2U, RJ45,  

USB, black APC Smart-UPS. (SMT1500RM12UC) 

Output power capacity: 151K) VA, 

Output power: 1000 W, 

Input operation voltage (min): 151 V 

Output Operation Voltage (MUK). 240 V 

AC outlet types: C 13 coupler, Serial interface type: RJ-45, Battery technology: 

Sealed Lead Acid 

Battery recharge time: 3 h, 

Typical backup time at half load: 25.8 min 

Form factor: Rackmount, 

Color of product: Black, 

Rack mounting: 2U 

Hold Time (max): 2ms 

Waveform: Sine
